maya_sec: Heads-up, we just merged the patched crate for the serde-cbor CVE into staging (PR #482). Patch bump from 0.11.2 -> 0.11.3.
jamie_sre: saw the deploy notification from dev-bot. running quick canary now.
dev-bot: deploy started: staging/rust-inference-runtime @maya_sec (1954321025)
jamie_sre: first smoke passed (health checks ok). sending a small synthetic traffic burst.
jamie_sre: hitting endpoints with 200 qps for 60s. grabbing latency histograms.
rui_runtime: FYI the patch changes a small internal encoding path; unlikely to change perf but possible allocation behavior.
jamie_sre: results: p50 ~ 18ms -> 22ms, p95 ~ 120ms -> 260ms on canary nodes. error rate unchanged.
maya_sec: hmm that's bigger than expected. no exceptions in logs, just slightly higher GC churn on the canary host.
rui_runtime: can you paste the tracer snapshot?
jamie_sre: attaching snippet:
```
# example tail of runtime metrics
2026-03-19T16:12:34Z host-a p50_ms=22 p95_ms=260 cpu_pct=72 rss_mb=1540 alloc_rate_kb_s=420
2026-03-19T16:12:40Z host-b p50_ms=20 p95_ms=240 cpu_pct=58 rss_mb=1498 alloc_rate_kb_s=398
```
maya_sec: allocation rate bump lines up with the encoding changes rui mentioned. could be a small regression from extra temporary buffers.
alexa_prod: tagging product since this touches latency for user-facing endpoints. @alexa_prod do we want to hold on prod roll?
alexa_prod: yes hold. will need SLO impact analysis if this persists.
rui_runtime: quick ideas: 1) run canary with env var `SERDE_CBOR_LEGACY_BUFFER=1` to enable alternate allocator path, 2) run with jemalloc tuning off, 3) add micro-benchmark for encode/decode.
jamie_sre: tried alternate allocator env var on one canary node, p95 dropped back to ~130ms — not ideal but much better.
maya_sec: that's good signal. suggests change interacts with allocator. might be safe to ship if we tune allocator or revert specific commit in crate while keeping CVE fix?
rui_runtime: easiest short-term: pin 0.11.3 but set env to use legacy buffer path and run full perf canary for 6 hours. i'll open a runtime PR to add the env toggle to staging config.
maya_sec: also let's add an audit log entry for the patch so we can track rollout and justification.
jamie_sre: started extended canary (6h) on 3 nodes. alerting threshold set at p95 > 200ms.
dev-bot: canary started: staging/canary-3nodes (1954321205)
maya_sec: follow-ups: (1) rui to open perf PR and microbench, (2) jamie to monitor canary and capture flamegraphs if threshold triggers, (3) security to prepare advisory note if we need emergency rollback.
rui_runtime: will do microbench and PR in next 2 hours.
jamie_sre: noted. will escalate to paging if p95 > 300ms or errors > 0.5%
maya_sec: thanks. keeping this thread as the canonical triage for the crate patch. will update once we have flamegraphs or decision to rollback. :eyes:
jamie_sre: minor update at 1954321360: extended canary p95 stabilized at ~140ms with env toggle, no errors. leaving in canary, will run the 6h window.
